firmware.title: DVK (eCat)
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, Mikhail Revzin
firmware.description: The DVK-1 to DVK-4 PDP-11 desktop computers, with KGD and KTsGD graphics. Emulated by eCat3; ROMs are built in.
firmware.controls: USB keyboard. F11: file browser, F12: settings; a key at power-on picks the model.
